score_scope: bounded checkpoint-specific signed20 lane-sliced accumulator RTL evidence

decision.reason: The frozen production campaign and a separately authored exact-SHA commercial-VCS hammer agree on signed20 arithmetic, 96-lane RMW, nonconflicting II=1, lazy valid clear, backpressured commit order, same-address fail-closed behavior and both overflow polarities. The evidence is strong for this RTL module but does not instantiate a foundry SRAM or execute the heldout payload-to-delta stream.

m115_arithmetic_bridge.frozen_scope: four H67 ep35 checkpoint INT8 weight payloads
m115_arithmetic_bridge.coefficient_contract: one PWP anchor plus at most one signed correction per source term
excluded_from_bound: weights other than the four frozen payloads
coefficient streams that exceed the M108 multiplicity contract
numeric effects outside the signed accumulator stage

findings.finding: The 96 arrays are behavioral synchronous memories, not selected foundry macros.
findings.impact: A 3072x20 geometry may be rounded, banked or implemented with different port semantics; 96 macro peripheries plus a 1920-bit update/commit fabric can dominate logical bit savings.
findings.required_next_evidence: Choose legal macro/compiler configurations, freeze read latency and RDW mode, then run macro-inclusive synthesis, STA and power.

findings.finding: No exact heldout payload-to-signed20-delta stream has been replayed through M116.
findings.impact: The M115 proof and M116 arithmetic implementation are separately strong, but payload lane ordering, sign extension, descriptor completion and actual update-address ordering remain an integration boundary.
findings.required_next_evidence: Use the M113-style integrated bridge and exact trace oracle; compare every accepted update and final commit.

findings.finding: The ingress is intentionally fail-fast rather than conventional hold-valid ready/valid, and consecutive same-address updates require a bubble or schedule proof.
findings.impact: A producer that holds valid while not semantically ready, or an unverified trace with adjacent equal addresses, permanently quarantines the module until reset.
findings.required_next_evidence: Freeze a credit-qualified pulse source or skid protocol and prove zero adjacent equal accepted addresses on the exact heldout trace.

findings.finding: There is no RTL-to-netlist equivalence, post-synthesis timing, SAIF/PTPX or matched signed24 physical baseline.
findings.impact: The 147456-byte saving is logical capacity only and cannot be converted to area, energy, clock or speedup.
findings.required_next_evidence: Run Formality and macro-inclusive DC/PT/SAIF/PTPX against the frozen signed20 and signed24 configurations.

findings.finding: Commit always scans all 8x384 vectors and has no valid_rows input.
findings.impact: The final 312-row W384 window incurs padded commit traffic unless an outer adapter drops data while still charging cycles.
findings.required_next_evidence: Keep padded cycles in the integrated ledger or add and independently verify a valid_rows-bounded commit iterator.

findings.finding: Same-address and overflow faults are sticky reset-only quarantine events with no offending update identifier.
findings.impact: System recovery and debug require an outer policy; the overflowing update is accepted at ingress but its write is suppressed one cycle later.
findings.required_next_evidence: Define fault attribution, reset/drain behavior and conservation counters in the integrated wrapper.

findings.finding: Signed20 is checkpoint-specific even though the RTL input type alone permits arbitrary signed20 deltas.
findings.impact: Reusing this instance for retrained weights or a dense fallback without rerunning M115 can silently invalidate the no-overflow guarantee.
findings.required_next_evidence: Bind checkpoint and weight-payload digests into the deployment contract; use signed22 for the current arbitrary dense INT8 envelope.

P1: Integrate exact payload-to-delta and heldout update replay.
Prove exact-trace same-address spacing and producer pulse protocol.
Select foundry macro configurations and close macro-inclusive timing and power.
Create a matched signed24 physical baseline before claiming area or energy benefit.
P2: Account for fixed full-window commit padding.
Define sticky fault attribution and recovery.
Bind signed20 admission to checkpoint and weight digests.

paper_safe_statement: For the four frozen H67 checkpoint INT8 payloads under the M108 coefficient-multiplicity contract, a signed20 W384 accumulator with 96 logical 3072x20 synchronous lane memories passed exact-SHA production and independent commercial-VCS directed verification, including nonconflicting II=1, lazy clear, commit stalls, signed endpoints and fail-closed positive/negative overflow. Its logical accumulator payload is 737280 bytes, 147456 bytes below signed24; foundry SRAM, physical PPA, exact heldout integrated replay and all cycle/system/headline speedup claims remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not call the 96 behavioral arrays foundry SRAM macros.
Do not call 737280 bytes measured macro area or energy.
Do not translate the 147456-byte logical saving into cycle, physical or system speedup.
Do not generalize signed20 to retrained or arbitrary dense INT8 weights; the frozen dense envelope requires signed22.
Do not call the M109 projection M116-measured performance.
